rules.requiredness: Task scope, the supplied dictionary and the field responsibility determine required scientific assertions. Reference prose is evidence, not an instruction to require every phrase.
rules.equivalence: Accept the same scientific meaning expressed through compatible wording, source-supported names, acronym expansion or order.
rules.field_locality: Required assertions must occur in their assigned submitted field. Other fields or linked rows can establish identity and interpretation but cannot fill missing content.
rules.explanatory_content: Background, repeated explanation, source locators and a reference-only explanatory caveat are not additional requirements unless the task or dictionary makes their scientific content necessary in this field.
rules.scientific_integrity: Require the requested membership, analysis, treatment, time, method, numerical content, uncertainty state and relationship roles appropriate to each field. An additional false or unsupported definite scientific assertion prevents whole-field credit.
rules.fixed_counts: Preserve one-to-one mapping, surplus and duplicate submissions, whole-field and complete-record counting, reference blanks, numerical precision and unit rules.
rules.unknown_states: Preserve task-required NR/NE, unknown or conflicting scientific states. Omission of an explanatory sentence alone does not assert a definite value; an unsupported definite replacement remains incorrect.
rules.identity: Use scientific identity independently of scores. Different requested analyses remain different objects even when they report the same number. A merged record supports at most one justified correspondence.
